commands.name: !xyzs
commands.response: $(user), you have $(getuservar $(user) xyzs 0) xyzs!

commands.name: !send_xyzs
commands.response: $(if $(arg1) $(if $(arg2) $(if $(>=$ $(getuservar $(user) xyzs 0) $(arg2)) $(setuservar $(user) xyzs $(calc $(getuservar $(user) xyzs 0) - $(arg2))) $(setuservar $(tolower $(arg1)) xyzs $(calc $(getuservar $(tolower $(arg1)) xyzs 0) + $(arg2))) $(user) sent $(arg2) xyzs to $(tolower $(arg1))! 🎉 You don't have enough xyzs!) Usage: !send_xyzs [username] [amount]) Usage: !send_xyzs [username] [amount])

commands.name: !queue
commands.response: $(user) joined the queue! Current position: $(addtolist queue $(user))

commands.name: !queue_list
commands.response: Current Queue: $(readfile queue.txt)

commands.name: !next
commands.response: $(if $(checkmod $(user)) Next in queue: $(removefromlist queue 1) Only mods can use this command)

commands.name: !slots
commands.response: $(if $(>=$ $(getuservar $(user) xyzs 0) $(if $(arg1) $(arg1) 5)) $(slots $(if $(arg1) $(arg1) 5)) You don't have enough xyzs for that bet!)

commands.name: !8ball
commands.response: 🎱 $(randomchoice Yes!|No!|Maybe...|Definitely!|Ask again later.|I don't think so.|Absolutely!|Not today.|100%!|Never!)

commands.name: !roulette
commands.response: $(if $(==$ $(random 1 6) 1) $(user) spun the roulette... 💥 Oops! You're out! $(user) spun the roulette... You're safe!)

commands.name: !uptime
commands.response: Stream uptime: $(uptime)

commands.name: !discord
commands.response: Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/2WAHvEW9

commands.name: !lurk
commands.response: $(user) is now lurking. Stay awesome! 👀

commands.name: !unlurk
commands.response: Welcome back, $(user)! You were missed!

commands.name: !hug
commands.response: $(if $(arg1) $(user) gives $(arg1) a warm hug! 🤗 $(user) sends a big hug to everyone! 🤗)

commands.name: !joke
commands.response: $(randomchoice Why did the streamer cross the road? To get more viewers!|Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Because light attracts bugs!|Why was the math book sad? It had too many problems.)

commands.name: !fact
commands.response: Did you know? $(randomchoice Twitch was launched in 2011.|Python is named after Monty Python.|The first emote on Twitch was Kappa.|xyzBOT is the coolest bot!)

commands.name: !meme
commands.response: Meme of the day: $(randomchoice Kappa|PogChamp|FeelsGoodMan|PepeLaugh|OMEGALUL|KEKW|PepeHands)

commands.name: !shoutout
commands.response: $(if $(arg1) Shoutout to $(arg1)! Check them out at https://twitch.tv/$(arg1) Usage: !shoutout [username])

commands.name: !addvip
commands.response: $(if $(checkmod $(user)) $(if $(arg1) $(addtolist vips $(tolower $(arg1))) $(tolower $(arg1)) is now a VIP! 🌟 Usage: !addvip [username]) Only mods can add VIPs)

commands.name: !removevip
commands.response: $(if $(checkmod $(user)) $(if $(arg1) $(removefromlist vips $(tolower $(arg1))) $(tolower $(arg1)) is no longer a VIP. Usage: !removevip [username]) Only mods can remove VIPs)

commands.name: !vips
commands.response: 🌟 VIPs: $(readfile vips.txt)

commands.name: !top_xyzs
commands.response: 💰 Top xyzs: $(toplist xyzs 5)

commands.name: !give_xyzs
commands.response: $(if $(==$ $(tolower $(user)) xyzdzn) $(if $(arg1) $(if $(arg2) $(setuservar $(tolower $(arg1)) xyzs $(calc $(getuservar $(tolower $(arg1)) xyzs 0) + $(arg2))) $(tolower $(arg1)) received $(arg2) xyzs! Usage: !give_xyzs [username] [amount]) Usage: !give_xyzs [username] [amount]) Only the streamer can give xyzs)

commands.name: !ban
commands.response: $(if $(checkmod $(user)) $(if $(arg1) /ban $(tolower $(arg1)) $(args 2+) $(tolower $(arg1)) has been banned. Usage: !ban [username] [reason]) Only mods can ban users)

commands.name: !timeout
commands.response: $(if $(checkmod $(user)) $(if $(arg1) $(if $(arg2) /timeout $(tolower $(arg1)) $(arg2) $(args 3+) $(tolower $(arg1)) has been timed out for $(arg2) seconds. Usage: !timeout [username] [seconds] [reason]) Usage: !timeout [username] [seconds] [reason]) Only mods can timeout users)

commands.name: !clear_queue
commands.response: $(if $(checkmod $(user)) $(clearlist queue) Queue cleared! Only mods can clear the queue)

commands.name: !stats
commands.response: Bot Stats: Commands used: $(getglobalvar commands_used 0), Active users: $(getglobalvar active_users 0)
